refnamediv.refpurpose: Restores the previously defined exception handler function

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
truerestore_exception_handler
Used after changing the exception handler function using set_exception_handler, to revert to the previous exception handler (which could be the built-in or a user defined function).
While an exception handler is running, no exception handler is active: as of PHP 8.3.0 the engine unsets it before invoking it, so that an exception thrown by the handler is not passed back to it.
As of PHP 8.3.5 the engine also pushes the handler it is about to invoke onto the handler stack. A restore_exception_handler call made from within an exception handler therefore pops that entry and re-installs the handler that is currently running; a second call is needed to install the handler that was active before it.
The running handler is re-installed automatically when it returns, but only if no exception handler is active at that point: a handler that calls set_exception_handler or restore_exception_handler is left in charge of the handler stack itself.
